clock.correction: Add 12 to unmarked hours below 8; leave other hours unchanged.
clock.row_order_check: Check non-decreasing corrected timestamps separately within each date before any sorting. Any reversal or invalid row fails validation.
clock.schedule_check: At least 95 percent of each Tuesday Patator label must be within its published interval plus or minus five minutes, measured from flow start.
clock.failure: Report corrected clock buckets as approximate and do not deploy any detector.

evaluation.malicious_window: Any non-benign flow in the source-window.
evaluation.family_denominator: Source-windows containing the attack family. Multi-family windows count for each matching family.
evaluation.full_flows: Use original full-stream rows, including repetitions, without the modelling sample's feature-vector deduplication.

uc3.baseline: Fit per-source medians and MADs on observed Monday source-minutes. For unseen sources use pooled observed Monday source-minutes.
uc3.score: Maximum signed upward robust z across the five features.
uc3.gaps: Inactive minutes are not observations and interrupt a consecutive run. Streaks reset at midnight.
uc3.alert: The second and subsequent consecutive qualifying minutes can trigger. Collapse triggers in each source and five-minute evaluation window to one alert.

ueba_reference.baseline: Initialize from observed Monday source-minutes, then update per source after scoring each later minute in corrected chronological order.
ueba_reference.score: Absolute sample-standard-deviation z-scores for eligible features, root sum of squares capped at 10.
ueba_reference.alert: Any anomalous minute triggers its source and five-minute evaluation window.

matched_family_comparison.definition: Separate diagnostic experiment. The fixed flow sample trains supervised models only in development source-windows, then full-stream test source-windows are scored by all-family and held-family models and compared to the same windows for the other methods.
matched_family_comparison.partition: BLAKE2b 8-byte big-endian integer of date|source_ip|five-minute-index modulo 10. Buckets 0-5 train, 6-7 validate, 8-9 test.
matched_family_comparison.calibration: Freeze each diagnostic XGBoost against benign validation flows at <=1% FPR using the existing tie-safe budget function. Remove the held attack family from supervised development.
matched_family_comparison.scope: Tuesday through Friday. The deployed candidate models remain the original chronological UC1b and UC2. Use the same 3-hit aggregation for diagnostic XGBoost models.
